results.title: Subroto Bagchi calls for immediate overhaul of India’s vocational ecosystem
results.content: Subroto Bagchi condemns the pervasive middle-class habit of labelling household helps as ‘servant maids’ and laments the persistent stigmas that treat vocational institutions as destinations only for youth who have ‘gone astray’

results.title: Toll plazas on Chennai-Tiruchi national highway gear up for Deepavali rush
results.content: A source in the National Highways Authority of India says that the contractors ensure that the toll operators and security guards do not go on leave. Boom barriers are positioned vertically so that no time is wasted in moving them up and down. However, Paranur plaza has a barrier-free toll system

results.title: Anaemia burden — iron alone is no solution
results.content: India must tackle its anaemia burden through targeted nutrition, better diagnostics and comprehensive public health measures, not salt fortification alone

results.title: Science should move past ‘top 2%’ label
results.content: India needs both fundamental research and practical solutions without making inclusion in the ‘top 2% scientists’ database’ the primary goal

results.title: Need for a unified urbanisation plan
results.content: The Union Budget, Economic Survey and Finance Commission recognise that India is urbanising across a rural-urban continuum. Yet Census 2027 will use the 2011 definitions, deepening the undercount of urban India; a National Urbanisation Policy can recognise this gap and build the institutional and fiscal mechanisms to bridge it

results.title: Maharashtra FDA seizes 4,002 kg of sweets from bus in Mumbai, ₹45 lakh food items in statewide crackdown
